QuestInfo.name: Karuppa
QuestInfo.0: The townspeople seem more frightened than is strictly necessary. Maybe Mascarpo knows why they're so skittish.
QuestInfo.1: If you can win Chief Gooda's trust, the townspeople will surely open up to you. But how best to bribe #bChief Gooda#k... Maybe you'd be better off just saying hello to start.
QuestInfo.2: You've greeted Chief Gooda, and he didn't run away shrieking, so that's a good sign, right? It sounds like the town is busy preparing for the upcoming ceremony.

npc.0: Did you say hello to #bChief Gooda#k?
